stages.title: REASON, REVELATION AND FAITH: THE BASIC PROBLEM
stages.terms: Reason appeals to publicly assessable inference, revelation to purported divine disclosure, and faith to committed assent or trust that may exceed demonstration.
stages.mechanism: Religious systems combine rational preambles, claims of disclosure and acts of trust in different proportions to justify belief and practice.
stages.consequence: Different weightings produce rationalism, compatibilism, critical faith and fideism, each with a distinct burden of proof.
stages.trap: Do not equate faith with unsupported belief or revelation with a self-authenticating proof available to every observer.
stages.answer: The philosophical problem is not whether religion uses only one source, but how rational inquiry, disclosed authority and committed trust can coexist without contradiction or arbitrariness.

stages.title: REASON, NATURAL THEOLOGY AND RATIONAL JUSTIFICATION
stages.terms: Role (2024 PYQ): reason (a) constructs natural theology (proofs for God), (b) tests coherence of doctrines, (c) interprets scripture, (d) defends faith (apologetics). ✅ Rationalism: religious beliefs must meet the bar of reason/evidence (Clifford: "it is wrong always... to believe anything upon insufficient evidence"). ✅ Limits: proofs are inconclusive (see Proofs note); the transcendent may exceed reason → space for revelation & faith. ⚠️ Rational vs irrational aspects of faith (2023): faith has a rational side (grounds, coherence, cumulative evidence) and a supra-/non-rational side (trust, commitment, the leap beyond proof). ⚠️.

stages.title: REVELATION, AUTHORITY AND DISCLOSURE
stages.terms: [!IMPORTANT] Revelation is an alleged divine self-disclosure that supplies truth or presence unavailable to unaided reason.
stages.mechanism: Final verdict: A revelation claim becomes philosophically credible only when disclosure, interpretation and public criteria are kept distinct.
stages.consequence: Non-propositional view (Hick): revelation is God's acts/self-presence in history & experience, humanly interpreted — not a set of dictated propositions.
stages.trap: Do not miss this limiting distinction: epistemic justification of revelation (2024 PYQ).
stages.answer: Revelation is an alleged divine self-disclosure that supplies truth or presence unavailable to unaided reason.

stages.title: FAITH, BELIEF, TRUST AND COMMITMENT
stages.terms: Final verdict: Faith is rationally responsible when it transcends evidence without violating coherence or ignoring defeaters.
stages.mechanism: Core argument/criticism: Aquinas explains faith as intellectual assent commanded by the will, while Kierkegaard stresses passionate commitment under objective uncertainty.
stages.consequence: This reconciles reason & faith — reason establishes the "preambles" (God exists), faith accepts the "mysteries" (Trinity) that exceed but don't contradict reason. ✅ Kierkegaard — faith as the LEAP: faith is a passionate, subjective commitment in "objective uncertainty"; the leap of faith transcends reason (Abraham's "teleological suspension of the ethical").
stages.trap: Do not miss this limiting distinction: faith is rationally responsible when it transcends evidence without violating coherence or ignoring defeaters.
stages.answer: Faith is firm trust and commitment that goes beyond conclusive proof without necessarily opposing reason.

stages.title: COMPATIBILISM, FIDEISM AND RIVAL STANCES
stages.terms: Final verdict: Aquinas offers the most balanced model when reason establishes preambles and faith assents to mysteries that exceed but do not contradict reason.
stages.mechanism: Final verdict: Aquinas offers the most balanced model when reason establishes preambles and faith assents to mysteries that exceed but do not contradict reason.
stages.consequence: The resulting consequence is that reason & revelation cannot conflict (both from God).
stages.trap: Do not miss this limiting distinction: aquinas offers the most balanced model when reason establishes preambles and faith assents to...
stages.answer: 🔑 Aquinas is the balanced default: reason & revelation cannot conflict (both from God); reason proves the preambles, revelation supplies the mysteries; faith is intellectual assent under grace.

stages.title: AQUINAS, KIERKEGAARD AND FOUNDATIONAL POSITIONS
stages.terms: [Aquinas] "How does Aquinas' faith-as-'intellectual assent' reconcile reason & faith?" (2025) → §3. [Reason] "Role of reason in religion." (2024) → §1. [Revelation] "Distinguish natural & revealed theology (propositional view)." (2025) → §2. [Justification] "Epistemic justifications of revelation-claims." (2024) → §2. [Faith-revelation] "Is faith indispensable for revelation?" (2022) → §3. [Science] "Significance of religion vis-à-vis present scientific and technological development." (2020, 10m) → §9.6 — Barbour's four models, not a Galileo narrative. [Faith/belief] "Basic tenets of faith; distinguish faith and belief." (2020, 15m) → §9.7 — enumerate the seven tenets, then the five axes. [Justification] "Can religious beliefs be justified?" (2023, 10m) → §9.9 — evidentialism vs Reformed epistemology; add the svataḥ/parataḥ-prāmāṇya mapping. [Reason regulative] "Can reason be a regulative force in forming religious beliefs?" (2021, 20m) → §1 + §9.1 + §9.9 — regulative ≠ constitutive; reason can veto and discipline without generating. [Rational/irrational] "Rational and irrational aspects of faith." (2023, 15m) → §9.5 — insist on supra-rational as a third category. [Miracles] "Can testimony establish a miracle?" → §9.8.

stages.answer: ✅ The Augustinian–Anselmian formula credo ut intelligam presents faith as seeking understanding. ✅ Aquinas places faith between demonstrative knowledge and wavering opinion: it is firm assent to what is not seen. ✅ Kierkegaard links faith with passionate inward commitment under objective uncertainty. ✅ Clifford's evidentialist maxim makes insufficient evidence morally relevant to belief. ❓ The popular formula credo quia absurdum is commonly associated with Tertullian but is not a safe verbatim quotation from him; use it only as a later slogan for extreme fideism.

stages.title: INDIAN AND WESTERN MODELS OF REASONED FAITH
stages.terms: Core argument/criticism: Mīmāṃsā (Vedic exegesis) defends authorless scripture and intrinsic validity, while Nyāya (logic and realist epistemology) requires externally confirmed credibility.
stages.mechanism: Core argument/criticism: Mīmāṃsā (Vedic exegesis) defends authorless scripture and intrinsic validity, while Nyāya (logic and realist epistemology) requires externally confirmed credibility.
stages.consequence: The resulting consequence is that mīmāṃsā (Vedic exegesis) defends authorless scripture and intrinsic validity.
stages.trap: Do not miss this limiting distinction: mīmāṃsā (Vedic exegesis) defends authorless scripture and intrinsic validity.
stages.answer: Indian epistemology reframes reason and revelation through pramāṇa (means of valid knowledge), especially śabda (verbal testimony).
